_note: The people and organisations a breaking story is about, and their X handles. Edited without a code change; the worker reads it again within a minute. Only entries with "verified": true are tagged, never kind "party". kind: person | department | party | company | institution | police. names_* / keywords_* are matched as whole words (Hindi and English) in the headline (first) or the points. District police and collectors stay in district-handles.json.

offices._note: An office named WITHOUT its holder ('CM ने भी स्वयं दी आहुतियां'): its handles are OFFERED, never tagged (reporter-prior brief 2026-11-13 §6). Resolved through the office, not the person, so it survives a change of officeholder. In 2,476 published posts an unnamed CM mention occurred 66 times, the desk tagged the CM on 0, and 26 were another state's CM or a former one. An alias is a whole word ('CM' never inside CMO, CMHO, ACM; 'मुख्यमंत्री' never inside 'उपमुख्यमंत्री'). exclude_same_sentence: any of these in the same sentence makes it another office. 'डिप्टी' / 'Deputy' / 'उप' were added to the brief's list so 'डिप्टी सीएम दिया कुमारी' is not the CM. Exclusions match without case ('former CM', 'FORMER CM'), anywhere in the sentence; an abbreviation's dot ('डॉ.', 'Dr.') does not end a sentence. exclude_next_to_alias: see its note. Handles must be entries of this file.

rajasthan_cm._exclude_next_to_alias_note: Short codes that are also other words: they make it another state's CM ONLY right beside the alias ('MP CM', 'MP के मुख्यमंत्री', 'UP के CM'), never elsewhere in the sentence: 'सांसद/MP ने CM से मुलाकात की' is still the Rajasthan CM. Matched with case as written.
